title: Model 1: would dropping R47 cost anything? Registered ensemble alternatives
scope: Registered non-inferiority test of R46 alone and R46+R49 against the production R46+R47 ensemble on the land-guarded test (173 scenes) and the SKN test (129 scenes).
summary: Neither registered candidate passed. R46 alone scored -0.012 IoU versus production on the land-guarded test (interval -0.018 to -0.006) and -0.026 on the SKN test. R46+R49 scored -0.018 on the land-guarded test (interval -0.029 to -0.006) and +0.064 on the SKN test (interval +0.013 to +0.129). Production R46+R47 remains selected. The control reproduced production at 0.6232 and 0.2146.

metrics.name: Production R46+R47 IoU, land-guarded test
metrics.provenance: 173 scenes, four-pass TTA, threshold 0.60, land mask; control reproduced to 4 decimals.

limitations: The source report is an untracked working-tree file; it is identified by SHA-256 only and has no source commit.
Both test sets use automatic labels; the land-guarded test was reused for earlier selection.
The re-evaluated production control (0.6232) does not reproduce the historical 0.6440 headline.
On human labels R47 is the weakest member, which the home automatic labels do not show; independent human adjudication of home scenes is needed.
R49 alone (0.5528 and 0.3903) and the three-checkpoint mean are descriptive, not promotion results.

evidence.summary: Section 4o of the final delivery report v10 with pre-registered rule and control gate.
